page.title: Composition, not decoration
page.description: Patterns are the approved ways to combine components into full page sections. They exist so that two teams building two products arrive at the same rhythm, the same use of yellow, and the same reading order.

groupFigures.markets: Markets in Central and Eastern Europe

hero.title: Brand hero
hero.description: The one place primary yellow fills a large area. Display type is Amalia Black with tight tracking; the primary action inside a yellow panel becomes the off-black outline, because yellow-on-yellow has no contrast.
hero.body: One design language across seventeen markets — so a corporate client recognises Raiffeisen before they read a single word.
hero.calloutBody: A yellow panel is a statement, not a container for dense content. Tables, forms and long prose belong on the default or subtle surface, where text contrast and reading comfort are highest.

statistics.title: Statistic band
statistics.description: Figures set in Amalia Black with tabular numerals, on the inverse surface so they read as a deliberate pause between lighter sections.
statistics.cardTitle: Card statistics on a light surface

bento.title: Bento builder
bento.description: Compose a bento layout by hand, then copy the JSX. The builder writes the same BentoGrid and BentoCard components the library ships, so what you paste is production code rather than a screenshot to rebuild.

features.title: Feature grid
features.description: Three or four cards, each with a leading yellow rule rather than an illustration. Card titles are h3 under the section h2, keeping the outline intact.
features.tokenDrivenBody: Colour, type, spacing and motion all resolve to tokens transcribed from the official palette. Rebranding a surface is a token change, not a component rewrite.
features.accessibleBody: Contrast pairs, a never-removed focus ring, 44px targets and documented keyboard behaviour are built into the primitives rather than retrofitted.
features.fullStackBody: The same contract runs through a typed API, so a form field and its server-side validation rule cannot drift apart.

corporate.title: Corporate band
corporate.description: Corporate green is the approved accent for ESG, sustainability and corporate-responsibility content. It sits alongside yellow — never in place of it.
corporate.heading: Financing the transition, market by market
corporate.body: Green appears where the content is genuinely about sustainability. Using it decoratively dilutes the signal and, over time, makes the claim harder for a client to believe.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every application with permissions needs one: an append-only record of who changed what, filterable and exportable, with the outcome carried by a labelled badge rather than colour alone.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Identity on the left, facts in the middle, switches the user actually owns at the bottom. Fields the organisation controls are marked read only instead of being silently disabled.

releases.title: Release notes
releases.description: A dated changelog where each line says what kind of change it was. The newest version sits on the subtle surface so the current release is obvious at a glance.

empty.title: Empty state
empty.description: An empty state names what is missing, explains why, and offers exactly one way forward. It is not an apology and not a dead end.
empty.heading: No pending approvals
empty.body: Everything assigned to you has been authorised. New instructions will appear here as soon as a colleague submits them.

auth.title: Auth & RBAC
auth.description: Sign-in, password recovery, a 403 boundary, and a role guard that shows exactly what each role can do.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Transient toasts for one-off events, and a persistent panel for everything a user might have missed.

wizard.title: Wizard
wizard.description: A multi-step form with a review step before submission, validated the same way every RBI form is.

upload.title: File upload
upload.description: A drop zone with per-file progress and inline errors — no request ever leaves the browser.

datagrid.title: Data grid
datagrid.description: Server-side paging, sorting and search against the same typed accounts API the API demo uses.

auditPattern.appendOnlyNote: Entries are append-only — an audit screen never offers edit or delete.

twoFactor.label: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Required for every account with administrative rights.

approvalEmails.label: Approval e-mails
approvalEmails.description: A message whenever an instruction is waiting on your authorisation.

weeklyDigest.label: Weekly digest
weeklyDigest.description: One summary of activity across the markets you follow.

changes.c1: Audit log, profile and release notes patterns.
changes.c2: Colour swatches inside every contrast-checker option.
changes.c3: Header navigation switches to the drawer earlier, so nothing overlaps.

changes.c1: Locale codebook plus reviewed value codebooks for EN, DE and HR.
changes.c2: Every shell string now resolves through a message key.
changes.c3: Deterministic number and date formatting, removing a hydration mismatch.

changes.c1: Bento layout builder with copyable JSX.
changes.c2: WCAG 2.2 contrast checker over the brand palette.
changes.c3: Control heights aligned at 40px across filters and buttons.

signIn.brandBody: The same credential set reaches corporate banking, treasury and reporting tools across all seventeen markets.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your work e-mail and password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your work e-mail and we'll send a reset link.
forgotPassword.note: If an account exists for that address, a link will arrive within a few minutes.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.body: Your current role doesn't include this permission. Ask an administrator to grant it, or go back to where you came from.

previews.viewer: Read-only access: can browse accounts and reports, nothing more.
previews.editor: Can edit records and export reports, but cannot manage other users.
previews.admin: Full access: manages users, roles and every editor permission.
